parent.selected: EMA.module only; independent strict load for every student and frozen teacher

data.augmentation: original final-phase weak RawAugmentation only: strong OFF throughout, sanitize + random horizontal flip + resize; sampler epochs109..120, augmentation epochs118..129; identical all arms
data.student_views: whole original RGB only before original augmentation, all arms identical

teacher.T1: original whole view0, same NMS/filter/teacher budget as T2; B-style teacher rather than raw A teacher
teacher.T2: C views0..4, original ceil(5H/9),ceil(5W/9) corner geometry
teacher.sort: score descending, view/query/category ascending; IDs only provenance
teacher.selection_order: map original coordinates -> original hard NMS -> top600 -> score>=0.5 -> top300 -> replay actual augmentation -> training ignore removal, no refill
teacher.precision: original FP32 sigmoid/decode; frozen C FP64 NMS; FP32 aligned KD tensors
teacher.pseudo_alignment: initial clip to original image; fixed weak trace only (strong trace rejected), actual horizontal flip, min_size1 before and after resize; empty retained; no random crop replay in production
teacher.ignore: reuse training negative_keep_mask on pseudo boxes with no matched exemptions, selected category only; no evaluation raster substitution
teacher.raw_audit: complete training raw views plus SHA/server only; no preexisting development cache reuse

KD.head: final normal decoder only
KD.matching: unchanged native Hungarian: 2*focal(alpha=.25,gamma=2)+5*L1-2*GIoU; no teacher/student query-ID equality
KD.classification: Bernoulli KL(q_teacher || sigmoid(student selected-class logit)); no other-class or unmatched KD
KD.denominator: max(1,sum q_teacher) per physical batch; empty yields differentiable zero
KD.supervised: unchanged all native VFL/L1/GIoU aux/encoder/DN terms and raw-ignore; GT and pseudo assignments separate

training.precision: BF16 forward FP32 supervised/KD loss; no scaler
training.optimizer: new AdamW, betas .9/.999, WD1e-4 except original norm/bn groups0; clip0.1
training.EMA: new copy of parent-loaded student incl buffers, updates0, decay.9999, warmups2000
training.RNG: reset Python/NumPy/torch CPU/CUDA seed0 after each independent construction; no arm-dependent random draws
training.endpoint: local FT012 EMA only; no intermediate AP or best epoch selection

evaluation.student_inference: original A single-view unchanged; no KD head or teacher at inference
evaluation.evaluators: original primary and COCO bridge; truncate then raw-ignore, no refill
evaluation.baseline: reuse certified original A/C seed0 metrics; no old AP recalculation

forward_budget.future_cost_fixed64: A,T0,T1,T2; 2 warmup +4 timed repetitions x16 batches each =384 forward calls; balanced four orders stated in PLAN.md

stop: new production engineering/numerical/identity/resource/restore anomaly STOP preserve; no automatic retry; science fail completes all fixed endpoints then closes recipe; no extra seed/epoch/parameter search
execution_gate: new separate GPU authorization after preparation review; no production token or GPU launcher in this preparation
